overview: Data Observability Root-Cause Triage addresses operational records arrive through different systems, supervisors reconstruct evidence manually, and decisions are difficult to audit in cross-industry cloud, data and ai operations. The first proof of value uses pipeline lineage, freshness checks and incident tickets. It produces a reviewed operational recommendation and a traceable decision record. The commercial success measure is mean time to restore trusted datasets, established from customer baseline data before any improvement is claimed.
kpi: mean time to restore trusted datasets

scope:
Delivery model: Redington or approved implementation partner, eligibility and staffing pending confirmation.
Duration: Discovery and design first; pilot and rollout durations depend on data access and scope; no fixed commitment.
1) Discover source quality and baseline: pipeline lineage, freshness checks and incident tickets; define mean time to restore trusted datasets and data-processing boundary.
2) Design control points, security and connector contracts; obtain owner approval from CIO / Cloud Platform Director.
3) Implement one bounded workflow, instrument missing-data exceptions and system-of-record write-back.
4) Test positive, negative, privilege, partial-data and rollback cases including line-by-line reconciliations against known business transactions.
5) Review KPI in the pilot, document evidence, perform training and agree transition.
deliverables: Agreed test threshold for mean time to restore trusted datasets
